skills.name: Double Sunday
skills.description: A wide corkscrew beam with strong knockback and balanced charge time.
skills.summary: Feixe largo em espiral com forte empurrão.
skills.subject: A wide violet and magenta energy beam spiraling as TWO thick intertwined corkscrew ribbons, launching from lower left toward upper right. Broad blunt bright white-violet leading impact, unmistakable double-helix silhouette with only two large turns. The spiraling energy fills the center. No hands or characters. Dominant violet, magenta, pale lavender; emphatically wide and blunt, not a thin lance.

skills.name: Tyrant Lancer
skills.description: A narrow offensive beam designed to pierce shields and distant targets.
skills.summary: Lança de energia que perfura escudos à distância.
skills.subject: A single long needle-sharp scarlet energy lance shooting from lower left to upper right and piercing a small teal translucent curved shield plane. Very straight, slender, aggressive spear-like silhouette with one white-hot tapered tip, two large angular shield fragments peeling away around its center. The red lance is the clear main subject; fractured shield is secondary and dark. Dominant crimson and orange-white; dark teal shield. No literal metallic weapon, no hands or people. Distinct from a wide swirling beam.

skills.name: Wolf Fang Fist
skills.description: Lunges at your opponent with five advancing strikes. The sequence stays in contact and its final hit deals medium knockback.
skills.summary: Cinco golpes em avanço e um impacto final.
skills.subject: A powerful large clenched martial-arts fist thrusting diagonally upward, its cyan blue ki aura shaping into the side profile of a snarling spectral wolf head just behind the knuckles. Fist and wolf flow as ONE compact central emblem. Five thick sweeping cyan motion strokes behind the fist suggest a rapid five-strike combo, kept subordinate to the large fist. Dominant ice blue, electric cyan, pale blue-white. Dark blue shadows, clean bold contours. No full character, no realistic animal, no gore.

Dominant warm ochre, amber, earth brown. Natural thrown rock, no fire, no lava, no glowing crystal, no magical runes, no ground.

skills.name: Shield
skills.summary: Barreira de ki que recebe ataques e consome energia.
skills.subject: A simple small dark humanoid torso silhouette fully enclosed in one large glowing spherical blue ki barrier. The protective sphere dominates the square as a nearly complete luminous circle with thick crisp blue-cyan rim and a broad softly translucent interior. One compact incoming orange impact star touches the outside of the right rim and is stopped, leaving the person untouched. Dominant royal blue, cyan and ice-white; tiny warm impact accent. Front three-quarter view, no physical metal shield, no hexagon mesh, no detailed person or face, no landscape.
skills.description: You can toggle this on and off. A ki shield will surround you to protect you from all attacks. Each attack will drain your energy instead of health. The shield will also protect you from dying in space but it will drain energy heavily.

skills.name: Zanzoken
skills.summary: Arranque de velocidade para cruzar uma distância curta.
skills.subject: One simplified luminous human silhouette leaning forward in a very fast rightward dash, with exactly TWO offset fading silhouettes trailing behind to the left, linked by three broad horizontal speed streaks. The solid leading figure is bright turquoise and the afterimages progressively darker teal. Bold angular running shape with readable head, bent leg and leading arm, no face details. Dominant mint turquoise, teal and pale white. A horizontal motion silhouette, not a portal, no wings, no full scenic illustration, no lightning bolt emblem.
skills.description: Zanzoken is the ability to use a burst of concentrated speed to reach a place very fast, it is so fast it is basically like teleporting a short distance. You click the spot you want to go to and your character will suddenly go there. The more you master this the less energy it will drain. You will also get a new command in the skills tab that lets you chase someone down using zanzoken if they try to run from you

skills.name: Heal
skills.summary: Cura alguém à frente, cedendo vida e energia.
skills.subject: Two large gently cupped stylized hands, palms facing each other, channel a bright small pearl of healing energy between them. A single broad emerald ribbon of light flows from the lower hand into the pearl and toward the upper hand, conveying life transfer and restorative care. Hands and orb form one simple compact emblem. Dominant luminous emerald green, mint-white center, deep forest green shadows. Expressive clean hand silhouettes, few finger separations, one thumb per hand. No medical cross, no plus sign, no heart-shaped symbol, no leaves, no text, no extra hands.
skills.description: You can heal anyone in front of you by giving up some of your own health and energy. If they have certain status problems they can be further alleviated by healing them, with multiple heals they may be cured.

skills.name: Solar Flare
skills.summary: Clarão intenso que cega quem está ao redor.
skills.subject: A blinding golden-white burst of sunlight, a central round white-hot sun with EIGHT massive sharp triangular rays, and two broad curved flare crescents wrapping the lower half. The sunburst is the single bold dominant shape with a brilliant center, angular rays and strong clean dark gaps. Dominant ivory white, bright gold, warm yellow, tiny orange at the base of rays. Much larger bright area than the other icons, but retain dark corners. No human face, no eye symbol, no scenery, no tiny starfield, no flames.
skills.description: Solar Flare blinds people. The range increases the higher your energy mod is. The time you will be blinded is solely dependent on your regeneration stat. How strong the person using Solar Flare does not affect the duration.
